description: Vulnerability classes used for labels and evaluation. Follows the DASP-style categories used by SmartBugs-curated, so results can be compared with that literature. Each class lists the SWC IDs that map to it.

access_control.summary: Missing or broken authorization: default visibility, unprotected selfdestruct or withdraw, tx.origin auth, wrong constructor name, delegatecall to untrusted callee, arbitrary storage write.

arithmetic.summary: Integer overflow or underflow (Solidity < 0.8 or unchecked blocks).

reentrancy.summary: State updated after an external call that forwards enough gas to re-enter.

bad_randomness.summary: Randomness derived from block data or other predictable on-chain values.

denial_of_service.summary: Contract can be blocked: unbounded loops or storage operations hitting the gas limit, or one failing call reverting a batch.

front_running.summary: Outcome depends on transaction ordering that users or miners can manipulate.

time_manipulation.summary: Logic depends on block.timestamp or block.number used as a clock.

other.summary: Known weaknesses outside the classes above, e.g. uninitialized storage pointer, signature malleability.
